# danielcward.com

> Daniel C. Ward is a UK-based web developer, photographer and tinkerer. He
> designs and builds software for the browser: production client work, small
> interactive tools, and shader experiments.

This file follows the llms.txt convention: a short orientation for AI systems,
followed by links to the pages that matter. Everything linked here is public
and requires no login.

## Pages

- [Home](https://danielcward.com/): Overview of client work, writing, experiments, and photography.
- [Client Work](https://danielcward.com/work/): Production projects designed and built end to end. Currently a custom WordPress service site for a bike repair shop and a branded site for a photography and cinematography studio. Both live in production, with case studies for each.
- [Notes](https://danielcward.com/notes/): Writing on the tools, decisions and dead ends behind the work — front-end architecture, shader programming, and photo archives.
- [The Lab](https://danielcward.com/lab/): Small interactive studies in shaders, variable typography, OKLCH colour, and layout systems. Work in progress; finished demos are published as their own pages.
- [Photography](https://danielcward.com/photography/): Landscapes and street work, shot slowly. Still being built; this page will link to the gallery once it opens.
- [Contact](https://danielcward.com/contact/): Available for freelance builds, front-end architecture, and client work from October 2026. Email danielcwardprojects@gmail.com.

## Elsewhere

- [GitHub](https://github.com/danielcwarduk)
- [LinkedIn](https://linkedin.com/in/danielcwarduk)

## Notes

Posts and demos are published as they are finished. Titles listed in the blog
and lab indexes may be works in progress; only published entries have a page
of their own, and the sitemap contains nothing else.
